observed_problem: The repository did not encode the Owner's review discipline that the five acceptance perspectives must be audited only after all candidate changes are complete. The previous closure performed a whole-candidate audit, then made additional repairs such as AUD-038, and relied on final CI without restarting the five-perspective semantic audit from zero.
expected_behavior: All planned and audit-discovered changes must finish first. Then freeze an exact candidate head and perform Weekly viability, Special viability, generality, Issue-recurrence prevention, and over-validation audits from scratch against that unchanged head. Any repository change that can alter the reviewed candidate invalidates the final audit and requires all five perspectives to be rerun from zero after changes finish. Recording the audit result outside the candidate branch, for example in the PR review record keyed to the exact head, must not mutate the audited candidate.
actual_behavior: docs/survey-production-core-v2-final-audit-rule.md now owns the mandatory order: complete all implementation/regression/document/Finding/Repair-Set synchronization, freeze an exact candidate SHA, run all five acceptance points from zero without candidate mutation, and invalidate the entire audit if any repository change is required. Authority, session bootstrap and AGENTS.md reference the same rule. The final PASS is intentionally recorded in PR/Human-review metadata keyed to the audited SHA rather than committed into the candidate tree after audit.

provenance.human_review_reference: Owner final-audit ordering rule stated in ChatGPT, 2026-08-22

improvement_action: Encoded the all-changes-first fixed-head audit rule, explicit audit invalidation after any candidate mutation, and external exact-SHA result recording.
